name: Match Mystery
description: Match-three puzzles with a hidden object component are the focus of the game Mystery Match Link 3 Puzzle. Create matches of three or more jewels to remove them from the board and move on to the next level. Hidden objects along the path must be found to solve puzzles and access new areas. The Mystery Match Link 3 Puzzle is simple but addictive. Simply drag and drop three or more jewels into a line to make a match. These power-ups can help you clear the board quickly or solve difficult puzzles.
